index_hero_sub: Businesses pay an agency once for custom POS, inventory, or dispatch software—then watch it go stale. With Kogane's Terminal Builder, configure presets once and let every platform improvement roll out automatically.

faq_q1: How do automatic preset updates work?
faq_a1: When Kogane ships an improvement to a core or shared preset, connected terminals can sync the update automatically while keeping your business branding, data tables, and permissions intact.
faq_q2: Do I need a credit card to try Starter?
faq_a2: No. Starter is $0/mo with 1 active terminal, core presets, and local or cloud testing. Upgrade only when you need more terminals or full audit history.
faq_q3: How does the Business plan handle extra terminals?
faq_a3: Business is $15/mo ($12/mo billed annually) and includes up to 5 connected terminals. Each additional terminal beyond 5 is +$5/mo.
faq_q4: Can we switch between Monthly and Annual billing or change plans?
faq_a4: Yes. You can switch billing cycles, add terminals, or move between Starter, Business, and Multi-Site at any time.
faq_q5: Why use a subscription instead of hiring an agency once?
faq_a5: One-off agency builds go stale quickly and cost thousands whenever workflows, tax rules, or screens need fixes. A lightweight subscription keeps every terminal maintained and synced continuously.
faq_q6: Can we export our operational data and audit logs?
faq_a6: Yes. Business includes CSV reports and full audit history, and Multi-Site adds full CSV and JSON audit log exports across all branches.

privacy_intro_body: This policy explains the information Kogane uses to create accounts, run workspaces, and support businesses.
privacy_data_body: We collect the information needed to create your account, run your workspace, keep access secure, and help with support requests.
privacy_data_identity: Account details such as your name, username, and sign-in email.
privacy_data_contact: Business details you choose to provide, such as your business name and contact details.
privacy_data_financial: Billing details only when billing is enabled for your account.
privacy_data_technical: Basic device and sign-in information needed to keep access secure and troubleshoot service issues.
privacy_usage_body: We use this information only for the following business and service needs:
privacy_usage_c1: Provide and improve your Kogane workspace.
privacy_usage_c2: Keep account and staff access secure.
privacy_usage_c3: Respond to support requests and meet legal obligations.
privacy_retention_body: We keep account and workspace information only for as long as it is needed to provide the service, meet legal requirements, resolve issues, and protect the service.
privacy_security_body: We have put in place appropriate security measures to prevent your personal data from being accidentally lost, used or accessed in an unauthorised way, altered or disclosed. In addition, we limit access to your personal data to those employees, agents, contractors and other third parties who have a business need to know. They will only process your personal data on our instructions and they are subject to a duty of confidentiality.
privacy_rights_body: Depending on where you live, you may ask to access, correct, or delete your information. Use the support contact provided with your Kogane account for these requests.
